info.title: Proxmate API
info.description: Single-admin LAN API. Configuration writes are immediate; infrastructure actions run in a serialized durable queue. Guest management requires reviewing a frozen plan, then confirming its ID. No automatic retries or rollback.

post.description: Pure validation; no Proxmox calls. Returned XML preview redacts password. POST /api/jobs with action=provision and confirmed=true to execute. Optional bootstrap prepares SSH/WinRM and guest-agent installation; the response includes a bootstrap_preview. verify=true requires VM purpose, start=true and a matching credential reference. post.description: Updates use the existing id. Connections are keyed by node:vmid. Secrets and records are encrypted at rest. post.summary: Review recovery or template lifecycle operation
post.description: Read-only Proxmox inspection. backup-restore requires node/vmid/storage/name/archive; refuses occupied IDs, creates unique identities and leaves the new VM stopped. Optional boot_test requires disconnected=true. backup-retention requires node/backup_storage/source_vmid, keep and older_than_days; returns exact candidates and preserves protected/newest archives. version-build requires family_id/recipe_id/vmid/name/label and optional start; Windows builds require fresh licensing/disk confirmation. Recipe tasks run only after verified bootstrap; otherwise remain planned. version-register requires family_id/node/vmid/label/prepared=true; stopped guests are converted and onboot disabled. template-test and version-clone require version_id/node/vmid/storage/name; testing always disconnects networking, boot-checks and retains the clone. version-promote requires version_id and successful test evidence tied to unchanged config. Plans expire after 30 minutes.

post.description: Use a target from task_recovery on the failed or interrupted job. Rechecks the original VM, disks and saved binding. Returns a management plan with id, targets, ordered tasks, snapshot_before, dangerous, recovery (job_id, completed, started) and finish_template. post.summary: Review a batch of new Windows Server, Ubuntu, Debian or Rocky Linux machines and software
post.description: Review os, name, count, purpose and ordered tasks. Windows ISO builds require source, inspected edition and password. Windows template builds require a stopped generalized source template and new Administrator password. Ubuntu ISO installs support Ubuntu Server 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 LTS amd64 and require a discovered source from simple/options. Rocky Linux 10 requires an x86-64-v3 node and accepts DVD, Minimal or Boot media or a prepared Rocky template. Minimal and Boot need guest DNS and HTTPS access to the version-matched Rocky repositories. Debian 13 installs accept ISO or template sources and default to the newest discovered compatible installer. Ubuntu cloud images remain available. Ubuntu reviews SSH fingerprints and optionally changes firewall and post-install background update settings. Placement and hardware overrides include node, storage, iso_storage, bridge, cores, memory in MB and disk in GiB. Review freezes the source identity, machine IDs, public keys, task bodies and inputs for 30 minutes. The response omits credentials.
